messages:
Alex Chen: Kicking off pilot scoping for HealthCo — they want embeddable summarization + sensitive-data redaction for user support triage. Can we align on endpoints + success criteria? (cc @Jordan (SE) @Priya Rao)

Priya Rao: High level: 2-week POC, 3 endpoints: 1) ticket summarization (short summary + tags) 2) PII redaction pipeline (PII removed) 3) semantic search over KB using embeddings. Need SLOs and eval prompts.

Jordan (SE): I can take the ticket summarization + embeddings. Questions: data residency — will they send logs, or connect via S3? Also SSO + Okta required.

Alex Chen: They'll connect via S3 (us-east-1) and expect redacted output returned to S3. Okta SAML required. Timeline: kickoff Mon week of 5/12, 2 weeks. Internal SE time: 10-15 hrs.

Samir Patel: Pricing ask from buyer: what's delta for Dedicated vs Hosted for this traffic? They expect 1k reqs/day, peak 5 RPS. Can we propose hosted with rate limits + fallback? Need a ballpark.

Jordan (SE): Ballpark: hosted with batching = ~$1.5k/month; Dedicated reserve starts at ~$6k/month + infra. I'll ask infra for exact calc.

Maya (CS): Security questionnaire link: https://redwoodcorp.share/HealthCo-SecQ.pdf — they flagged encryption at rest, KMS integration, audit logs retention. Security team will need HLD + network diagram.

security-bot: Security checklist uploaded: /internal/security/healthco-hld-reqs.md

Priya Rao: Success criteria draft:
- Summarization: F1 > 0.8 vs human baseline on 200 sample tickets
- PII redaction: zero PII in output on 500 test cases
- Embeddings: mean reciprocal rank (MRR) > 0.7 on KB queries
- Latency: p95 < 500ms for summarization in hosted mode
- Ops: end-to-end flow (S3 in -> S3 out) automated

Alex Chen: Prioritization matrix (prio: critical/high/medium):
- Ticket summarization: Critical
- PII redaction: Critical
- Embeddings search: High
- SSO/Okta: Critical (blocker for ent procurement)
- Compliance docs: High

Samir Patel: Action items:
1) Jordan: prototype summarization prompt + evaluation harness (due Wed)
2) Security: provide HLD + KMS runbook (due Thu)
3) Sales: send pricing estimate and comparison hosted/dedicated (due Fri)
4) CS: schedule kickoff w/ customer and get sample data consent (due Mon)

Jordan (SE): Quick prompt I want to try:
```
Input: <ticket_text>
System: Produce a 2-sentence summary and up to 3 tags from: billing, login, refund, bug, feature-request
```
I'll run 200 samples + save eval script.

Priya Rao: Can we add an acceptance test for redaction: include edge cases (SSN formatted weird, images?) They won't provide images in POC.

Alex Chen: FYI legal flagged data retention — they want retention 30 days. We'll surface to product for config.

Maya (CS): Customer asks about support during pilot — can we offer Oncall hours? We can offer limited oncall between 9-5 PT.

Samir Patel: Pricing note: include estimate for caching (embeddings store) and batching impact. Also include a note about potential quantized model to lower cost.

Priya Rao: OK this thread is the single source of truth. If no objections I'll ship the draft SOW and checklist tonight.

Jordan (SE): 👍 I'll drop early results tomorrow.

Alex Chen: Thanks all — tagging @security-bot for trace. :thumbsup:
